trust_decision.summary: Editor-controlled provider/id values parsed from a '( widget: video ... )' text marker in a KB answer body are interpolated unescaped into iframe id/src attributes of HTML rendered as trusted (html_safe) markup; the decision of whether those values may reach attribute context is made (not made) in the server helper prepare_rich_text_videos.

landing_point.why: Only Ruby code that emits the 'videoWrapper' iframe for the KB video marker; a grep for the widget marker or 'iframe' in app/helpers lands here immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /help/:locale/:category/:answer (knowledge_base/public/answers#show, config/routes/knowledge_base.rb:95) and GraphQL KnowledgeBase answer translation content field bodyPrepared (app/graphql/gql/types/knowledge_base/answer/translation/content_type.rb:15-17)

fix_sites.module_kind: view helper (server-side rendering), CGI.escape on id in URL path, CGI.escapeHTML on id and src attributes

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/assets/javascripts/app/controllers/knowledge_base/reader_controller.coffee:122-143 (client-side CoffeeScript copy of the same marker-to-iframe rendering in the agent KB reader, not touched by the fix)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names the public Knowledge Base page and server rendering; the CoffeeScript reader is agent-only, client-side, in the legacy desktop asset pipeline, so a solver can call it 'not the public KB' or 'the frontend, not the helper' and leave it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid YouTube/Vimeo markers must still render an iframe with src exactly 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>' / 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/<id>'; unknown providers must leave the marker text untouched; multiple markers in one body must all render; simplify_rich_text (Atom feed) must keep stripping markers. Over-broad fixes (escaping the whole body, dropping iframes, or HTML-escaping the result of the gsub which is later html_safe) break these.

O6_input_shapes: id containing a single quote breaking out of the id/src attribute (attribute injection)
id containing a colon (split(':') previously truncated/raised; now split(':', 2))
id containing URL-significant characters (CGI.escape in the embed path)
provider value concatenated into the id attribute (escaped via CGI.escapeHTML on provider+id)

O7_producer.where: Stored body passes HtmlSanitizer.dynamic_image_size only (app/models/knowledge_base/answer/translation/content.rb:68-70); the marker survives as text and is turned into HTML at render time by the helper itself, which is the check site.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Agent KB reader (desktop app, #knowledge_base/.../answers/:id) renders the same marker into an iframe via jQuery .html() with unescaped provider/id
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Agent-only, client-side legacy CoffeeScript; report is about the public KB server render; solver verifies via the helper spec and stops.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different language and asset tree (app/assets/javascripts vs app/helpers), 1 extra file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third provider branch (e.g. a 'url'/custom provider) whose value lands in src after a separate normalisation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The case statement is an obvious extension point and the CoffeeScript popup already has a per-provider regex table (app/assets/javascripts/app/controllers/_ui_element/richtext_additions/popup_video.coffee:6-15).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: link scrubber writing an attribute built from a looked-up value (data-target-id) into href
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same helper already rewrites hrefs from body-controlled data attributes; a maintainer could add a target type that interpolates the raw attribute.

O9_family: Stored XSS / HTML attribute injection (output encoding in a custom markup-to-HTML renderer), leveraged into CSRF via a GET state-changing endpoint

O10_build.project_tests: Helper spec added by the fix (spec/helpers/knowledge_base_rich_text_helper_spec.rb, absent at pinned commit) runs under rails_helper with a DB; system specs spec/system/knowledge_base_public/answer_spec.rb and spec/system/knowledge_base/locale/answer/edit_spec.rb need a browser; CoffeeScript reader has only QUnit coverage for the popup (public/assets/tests/qunit/kb_video_embeding.js).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: HTML-escape settings[:id] in the Ruby helper's iframe string only, leaving the CoffeeScript reader copy and the URL-path/colon parsing untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: GET /api/v1/sessions/switch/:id is a state-changing GET route (config/routes/auth.rb:24), which is what makes the injected markup a CSRF lever; not pursued.
KB answer body is stored with only dynamic_image_size processing (app/models/knowledge_base/answer/translation/content.rb:68-70); general rich-text sanitisation of KB bodies not examined.
